comparability.interpretation: The table supports descriptive placement on the same error scale. It does not support a causal or statistically paired improvement claim.
comparability.reason_not_paired: The prior Contract E preparations use Philox keys [seed, domain_tag] and float64 raw draws cast to float32; Cubature/GenUT uses stateless keys [seed, horizon] and [seed, horizon+100].
